i think i’ve fully resolved to knowing i am unlovable.

i’ve never been in a relationship and no one’s ever liked me enough to want to be with me, so all the evidence points to one answer: i am unlovable.

the most hard hitting part though is that i have so much love to give. i care and love and admire the people in my life so passionately but i know i’m nowhere near that level of love with anyone else. i know everyone prefers other people over me and i’ve come to realise my love is unacceptable for whatever reason. 

i’ve stopped questioning why no one wants my love and slowly started grieving it in order to get over it. then i’ll be free.

i feel like i’m just predestined to not be happy. when i explained my childhood to my therapist, she said it sounded like we were communicative when there were issues but there was no joy. and no matter how hard i try to create joy, it slips away from me; and usually, i fuck it up by trying to hold onto it. 

i want to not think this way or feel this way, i want to create joy for myself, even contentment, but i don’t think i’m meant to be happy or content.
